stories.title: India win the Test series 1-0 in Sri Lanka
stories.body: the 2nd Test at Colombo ends in a draw on 27 August after Sonal Dinusha's unbeaten 133* (following-on) saves Sri Lanka; India had declared at 503-9; debutant spinner Saransh Jain among the wicket-takers.

one_liners: India win the Test series 1-0 in Sri Lanka — the 2nd Test at Colombo ends in a draw on 27 August after Sonal Dinusha's unbeaten 133* (following-on) saves Sri Lanka
